basic_info.description: Welcome to 266 Athens St, a charming San Francisco residence offering versatile living arrangements and investment potential. This well-maintained two-level home combines classic character with modern convenience, making it an exceptional choice for those seeking comfort, flexibility, and an unbeatable location.  The lower level, delivered vacant, is ready for immediate use or customization, offering the opportunity to make it truly your own. Spacious and inviting, it provides ample possibilities for either personal use or rental income. The upper floor, tenant-occupied, ensures a steady income stream, making this property an ideal investment in one of the city's most dynamic neighborhoods.  Each level enjoys thoughtful layouts with well-sized rooms, abundant natural light, and a welcoming ambiance throughout. Located close to schools, parks, local dining, and transit, 266 Athens St offers both convenience and a vibrant neighborhood experience. Whether you're looking to establish a primary residence with income potential or expand your real estate portfolio, this property offers unique possibilities in San Francisco's thriving market.
